Our Sanctuary

A Quiet Haven in Nishat Bagh

Nestled near Srinagar's historic royal gardens, The Orchids Cove blends traditional Kashmiri woodwork (Khatamband) with modern minimalist luxury.

Whether sipping freshly brewed saffron Kahwa on your private balcony or taking a morning stroll along the shores of Dal Lake, every moment is curated for stillness and serenity.
